newsitem.title: USA: Century Telephone tests wireless loop system.
newsitem.headline: Century Telephone tests wireless loop system.

text.p: Century Telephone Enterprises Inc said it is conducting in Marion, La., a trial of what it called the first copper-equivalent, wireless local loop system available in the United States.

It said the system delivers all the basic and enhanced voice and a data services of today's wired telephone service network over a wireless network, without the cost of copper or fiber connection maintainance.
TTN Inc, a unit of Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd, is supplier of the system, known as multigain wireless local loop system.
It said the trial will help it evaluate the operational requirements in the deployment of wireless telephone service on a large scale and identify potential bandwith and service limitations.
